build_system: Bun 1.4.4 with electron-vite. Scripts are in global-sct/package.json.
test_framework: node:test with node:assert/strict, run by `bun test` from global-sct/tests (script `bun run test`). Playwright Electron specs are tests/*.spec.ts.
rules: TypeScript only. Do not use the `any` type.
Never run `tsc` directly. Use `bun run typecheck:tsc` from global-sct/. A brief that says `tsc --noEmit` means this script.
Each ticket writes and runs the tests for its own module (override 1). Changes to existing tests need an approval in the ticket.
Zod is the schema library. Do not add Effect Schema.
Do not edit a locked file. Write a SCOPE REQUEST as an alternative.
Do not edit agtop/** or subagentclassifiertoolkit/**. They are read-only pinned clones.
Process roles come from agtop at run time. Do not write a process-role classifier.
Tests: avoid mocks, do not use globalThis.*, test the real implementation, and do not copy logic into a test.
Inline a value that is used one time. The main function shows the success path and helpers go below it.
Add comments only for constraints and surprising behavior. Write comments and reports in simple technical English (ASD-STE100).
UI: Hallmark OKLCH role tokens only. No Tailwind, no literal colors or font families, no shadows, no rounded corners.
Do not add a dependency. Do not change package.json or bun.lock.
key_patterns: styles.css: `:root` holds Terminal token values; `:root[data-theme="cream"]` replaces token values only. Accent role tokens: --color-accent (fill), --color-accent-ink (text on fill), --color-accent-text, --color-accent-line, --color-accent-edge, --color-focus, --color-hover-ink. Current Cream block sets --color-accent oklch(46.1% 0.121 145) and --color-accent-ink var(--color-paper-2), but does not override --color-accent-text, --color-accent-line, or --color-focus, so Cream links, status text, focus rings, and lines are green now. The header link uses `.header-start nav a[aria-current="page"]::after` (2px accent bar below). The sharing tab uses `.sharing-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-accent); border-top-color: var(--color-accent) }` (green text). Inputs: `input { border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-2) }` and the select rule `.sharing-section select, .panel select, .relay-inbox select, .import-dialog select, .appearance select { border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-2) }`. Theme preference: src/main/preferences.ts writes userData/preferences.json; src/main/index.ts loadTheme sets nativeTheme.themeSource and passes --sct-theme; renderer main.tsx sets data-theme on <html>. Storage > Appearance has <select id="theme-select"> labelled Theme (light/dark/system). CLI: src/main/launch.ts requireRunArguments(args) is not exported.
environment_constraints: Linux x64, Bun 1.4.4. One git worktree for each ticket. A worker commits on its own branch only. The schema 1 record in legacy/ described a shared Windows checkout; that text no longer applies.
